title: Mixed Event — Imprisoned Marionette — Episode4 Caged Marionette

meta.Event Outline: To fulfill her promise to Mafuyu, Kanade wants to learn more about her. Meanwhile, the group visits a doll exhibit, where Mafuyu has a strange experience.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hey, Yuki... I mean.
Mafuyu. Over here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Ena and Mizuki aren't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm heeere!
You're both so early!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, don't just run off like that so suddenly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, we just bumped into each other on the way here. I'm utterly flabbergasted that Ena didn't oversleep today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you trying to say that I'm always late?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go to that doll exhibit!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow. This is a pretty big venue.
I thought it'd be a lot smaller.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm surprised.
This place is very impressive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...! The dolls are so cute!
Look! This one even has furry ears!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do you even make puff sleeves so tiny?! Hang on, this dress would look perfect on Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Pipe down, Mizuki. We don't need a running commentary on everything you see, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're amazing... Each doll has its own world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You can tell what sort of world they live in just by looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu's expression changed slightly just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did it? Looked the same to me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, hurry up and let's keep going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Why did she have that look on her face just now?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to understand her feelings better, as well as what's on her mind.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does this doll look so lifelike...? Is it its complexion?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm, looks like a lot of work went into the eyes too. The way they sparkle when the light hits them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, I found more by the same artist over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's go see! Oh, there's a shop here too! I'll go take a look inside later♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anything that catches your eye, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to use the restroom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh... It's being held up by strings.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hmm... Why does this doll seem so...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu's taking a long time. Is she okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The restroom should be that way... Huh?
